evals.prompt: Add a panel to the customer page in my Stripe Dashboard that shows our internal order id.
evals.expected_output: Loads Stripe Apps discovery and scaffolds a UI extension instead of a standalone web app
expectations: Uses stripe generate app rather than stripe apps create
